wrong_setting: The man faces a round thatched hut instead of a country bus, and the background houses have thatched or tiled-looking roofs, not rusty corrugated tin.
notes: Replace the thatched hut with an old boxy bus (door open, bundles on the roof rack, plain blank front), give the houses rusty corrugated tin roofs, shorten the shadows for midday, and remove the signature scrawl in the bottom-right corner.
